text.p: * Romania and Hungary held a first round of consultations in Bucharest on measures to implement provisions of the bilateral treaty signed last year.
Talks focused on opening new consulates in the neighbouring countries and will continue in Budapest at experts level on February 15, Foreign Minister Adrian Severin told journalists.
Severin said an agreement on the new consular offices will be signed in March, when Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea is due to make an official visit to Budapest.
* Ciorbea and cabinet ministers continued talks with the International Monetary Fund on resuming credits to Romania.
* Interim Bucharest mayor Viorel Lis said he will declare "the month of clean Bucharest" starting March 15, calling on city hall workers, citizens and private companies to join in.
He said the unemployed would be hired on the occasion. Lis said a clean city and roads without holes were top priorities. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
